title: Launch Thermometer — Roadmap Signal Sheet
content:
Overview:
This is a compact, prioritized readiness tracker designed to act as a "thermometer" for multiple concurrent launches. It blends qualitative blocker notes, binary gating, and a weighted numeric readiness score to give a single-line snapshot per initiative for product ops and launch owners. Use this as the single source for go/no-go signals during the last 4 sprint weeks before release.

Scoring methodology (summary):
- Areas (weight): Engineering: 35%, QA & Reliability: 20%, Documentation & UX: 10%, Security/Legal: 10%, GTM (content + sales enablement): 15%, Observability & SRE runbooks: 10%
- Each area recorded as a percent ready (0–100). Weighted Readiness = sum(area_percent * area_weight). Round to nearest integer.
- Readiness bands: Red: 0–49, Yellow: 50–79, Green: 80–100.
- Launch risk note required for any Red or Yellow band entry.

Sheet table (columns):
Initiative | Owner | Target Release | Priority (1-5) | Eng % | QA/SRE % | Docs/UX % | Legal/Sec % | GTM % | Obs/SRE Runbooks % | Weighted Readiness % | Band | Key KPI(s) | Leading Signal | Launch Blocker(s) | Contingency / Fallback | Next 7-day Owner Actions

Rows (examples):
1) Adaptive Batching for Chat API | Priya Kumar | 2026-03-31 | 1 | 78 | 70 | 60 | 100 | 45 | 55 | 72 | Yellow | p50 latency <= 80ms, Cost/token -10% | Canary latency trend improving 3 consecutive days | GTM collateral delayed; feature flag gating not wired for some clients | Delay soft launch to phased rollout + enable older routing path | 1) Complete canary autoscale tests (Rafael) 2) Finalize feature flag matrix (Priya) 3) Draft customer comms outline (GTM lead)

2) Private Deployments v2 (VPC automation) | Rafael Diaz | 2026-04-14 | 1 | 62 | 55 | 85 | 70 | 75 | 50 | 65 | Yellow | time-to-onboard < 2 days, number of manual steps <= 5 | Beta installs failing on 2/5 network configs | Major automated cert rotation missing in terraform templates | Offer manual install path + professional services assist for first wave | 1) Run infra test harness for 5 network topologies (Rafael) 2) Legal finalize SOC2 addendum (Aisha)

3) Hosted API — Streaming Stability Sprint | Noah Ellison | 2026-03-24 | 2 | 90 | 88 | 80 | 100 | 60 | 95 | 88 | Green | streaming error rate < 0.05%, retention >= 99.9% | Error rate falling; retention stable | Minor edge-case producing truncated chunks under long prompt | Patch and deploy low-risk hotfix to canary (SRE) | 1) Merge hotfix PR #344 (Noah) 2) Update release notes + metrics dashboard (Docs)

4) Optimize: Auto-quantization Recommendation UI | Aisha Patel | 2026-04-01 | 3 | 40 | 35 | 50 | 100 | 30 | 25 | 40 | Red | model throughput uplift per quantization profile | internal usability test shows confusion; infra not fully wired | Backend quantization pipeline incomplete | Hold internal beta; postpone public rollout | 1) Prioritize the quant-pipeline epic (Infra) 2) Schedule 2 UX sessions this week (Aisha)

Guidance on use:
- Owners should update percent columns daily during the final 14 days before release; product ops will review changes during the weekly launch sync and daily standup in the final 5 days.
- Any initiative that moves into Yellow or Red must fill the "Launch Blocker(s)" and "Contingency" columns.
- Use the Leading Signal column to capture a single metric/trend that should trigger escalation (e.g., canary latency trend, install failure rate, docs sign-off missing).

Launch Preflight Checklist (compact):
- Engineering: All critical tests passing in canary environment; lint and security scans cleared; feature flags validated in staging.
- QA/SRE: Load and resiliency runbooks executed; rollback validated; error budget check completed.
- Docs/UX: Quickstart + migration guide published; screenshots and API samples included.
- Legal/Security: Data processing addenda completed for customers in scope; threat model updated.
- GTM/Support: Sales playbook and triage runbook completed; support has run internal dry-run.
- Observability: Dashboards created, alerts configured, burn-in tests executed.

Quick escalation rubric (for product ops):
- If Weighted Readiness drops >= 15 points week-over-week => immediate triage (exec note to VP product + SRE).
- If Key KPI is forecasted to miss target by >20% at launch => consider staged release or partner-only rollout.
- Any unresolved security/legal blocker => hold release until remediation verified by security/legal owners.

Notes / Vault for ephemeral context (notes to self style):
- This sheet intentionally balances speed (binary gates) and nuance (weighted readiness). Expect some noisy day-to-day movement; prefer 3-day smoothing for final decisioning.
- Link canonical launch playbook when promoting to final: CONFLUENCE-PLATFORM-1423.
- Action item: discuss weighting adjustments after the "Private Deployments v2" run to ensure SRE weight reflects new on-prem complexities.

Change log (edits):
- 2026-02-10 Lena Chen: initial scaffold and weight definitions.
- 2026-02-20 Rafael Diaz: added contingency examples and escalation rubric.
- 2026-03-10 Priya Kumar: prefill rows for active launches and adjusted GTM weight from 20% -> 15%.

End of sheet.
